summary: The filing is an 8-K containing only XBRL-tagged financial statements and exhibits with no narrative disclosure of any special-situation event. Roku, Inc. filed the 8-K under Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits), but the provided excerpt consists solely of inline XBRL metadata for standard periodic reports, segment data (Advertising, Subscriptions, Platform, Device), and balance sheet accounts. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situations catalyst. The filing appears to be a routine incorporation of updated financial data without any corporate transaction or event that would qualify as a special situation.
